name: Europäischer Fernwanderweg E5, Schweiz
description_md:
The Europaeischer Fernwanderweg E5 in Switzerland is a hard, waymarked hiking route covering a distance of 233.3 km. This international waymarked hiking route requires about 66 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule.

The route features 3012 m of ascent and 2865 m of descent. It is signposted as E5, and the line matches the official route published by swisstopo. The path passes Wörth Castle within 100 m, Restaurant Schloss Laufen within 200 m, and Basel within 2000 m.
